# Waymark 0.5.0

- Public Waymark website with Windows downloads, Npcap installation instructions, help and player search.
- View online opens your detected character page. Connect once using the website account to enable automatic sync.
- Connected installations sync pet progress, collection totals and cumulative usage every 30 seconds, with bounded offline retry.
- Private workspace snapshots keep settings, routes, custom pins and window layouts separate from public profiles. Manage devices and visibility on the website.
- Pet farming locations now list your faction’s home region before alternative maps.

Automatic sync needs a one-time account link. Public pages contain app observations, not official account verification. No new in-game position or completion decoder is claimed. Cloud saves download as JSON; automatic restore is not included.
